speedrun_tips: Follow the Water
There are 2 Variants for Cavern of Anger. The Exit of the Zone is always in the North-East Corner of the Zone. You can identify which one by checking the Upper Bridge at the Start.
If it leads to a Dead End, you are in the North Variant. Move North-East along the River and the West Edge.
Otherwise, you are in the East Variant. Move East along the River.
Follow the Water
Cavern of Wrath has 2 Variants, to determine which one you are in see in which direction the Water flows. Either by following the River or literaly by watching the Water
Follow the River in the direction the Water flows / the Zone extends to.
This is a great Zone to have some Practice in, as once you run it a couple of Time conciously you get a Feel for the Direction it should be going.
Legion Monolith
Follow the West Edge from the Entrance. Detailed Example seen in the Image above.

There are always 5 Slopes / Ledges you have to take before you will reach the Lower Prison Entrance. The Legion Monolith is always before the last 2. Following the Direction the Zone opens, while orienting yourself along the Left Edge of the Zone. If the first Ledge has a C shaped Hook, like in Image 3 or 4, the Exit will be in a Straigth line from that Hook.
Waypoint
The Golden Rule of Coast is that Waypoints and Exits have to be on Water Level.

Generally Walk East / North-East to identify the direction the Layout is extending. Follow along the Coast and try to get a Layer down for each Layer that you go upwards. A Layer up is indicated by a Ledge / Slope.
There is one variant that goes southwards. The South Variant places you facing South at the North Edge, all other Layouts that place you facing South open up North.
When identifying the Layout as the Long Coast, consider logging to Town and making a new Instance, it is faster than running the Zone.
There are 2 major Zone Identifiers, the Handgun and the Cookie Bite

For the Handgun Layout check the Wall behind it, if you can't walk past it (like in Image 3), head south / south-east. If you can walk past it (like in Image 4), follow along the opposite Zone Edge to get to the last Ledge downwards and Waypoint.
For the Cookie Bite Layout check the Wall that you will walk into if you go North-East. If it is an Indent (like in Image 8), you are in the Long Coast.
Ignore all Enemies here, Click on Corpses that you are pathing along for additional Loot
Essence encased Deep Dweller
The Zone opens up in any one of the cardinal Directions: North, East, South, or West.
You can identify in which direction based on the Directions the Zone ends in.

As Example in Image 1 the Zone ends South-East and South-West, you are forced to path towards North. Or in Image 2 where the Zone ends West and you see a bit of Passages going both North or South. So the Zone has to go East and all North and South Passages will lead to Dead Ends.
You can draw a Arrow on the Zone in the Directions the Layout ends, and in the opposite will be the Boss.
2 Skippable Bosses Waypoint

On Right Facing Variants it would be slightly faster to not take the Goat Passage, however it is highly Recommended to always take the Goad Passage for it excelent Source of Experience. During the Goat Passage, you will get near a Campfire, once you get in close Range, The Faun will drop and kill all Goats surounding the Campfire.

So the way to follow the Zone always stick to the Mountain Side Wall till you get out of the Goat Passage, then stick to the Water Side Wall to avoid the AoE Explosion of the Totem Boss, Kuduku the False God.
Waypoint Trial of Ascendancy
The Yellow Lines are the pathing when logging.

Lower Prison is overall a very simple Layout, once you understand its rule set. To identify the layout you are in, first check the North-East Path. If it is a Dead End, you are guranteed in the East Variant, seen in Image 1.

If it is not a Dead End, but the Trial is in a straight line from Waypoint, the Exit is in the South-West Corner. If you have fast loading Screens, it is faster to log and go from the Waypoint, otherwise you can walk East first, then get to the Exit in a straight line. (Image 2)
If you see the Trial, but it is facing North-West, same direction the Entrance is to the Waypoint. Then the Exit will be in the far East Corner. Like in Image 3.
If the Zone does a L-Turn east, follow the Zone to see the Trial, the Exit will be in the South-East Corner after the Trial.

Finaly if you do not see the Trial when going North-East, but the Zone continues, the Trial will be in the East corner of the Zone. There are 2 Sub-Variants. Fair ones and Super Scuffed ones. In a Fair one you will see the Exit, then can turn East to get to the Trial and after completion walk directly to the Exit. Seen in Image 5. But in the Scuffed one it is better to log out, even with long loading screens, as the Trial is in a massive Dead End. Seen in Image 6.
3 Rhoa Nest Entrance to Submerged Passage (needs unlocking)

The perfect Read for Mud Flats can be a bit complicated, the simple Rule is that all 3 Nests are in a Trinagle Pattern, so just learn to differentiate between the Major Layout Variants: East, North and South. Then just look for Quest Markers and Exit in the general Direction of the Variant.
There are 3 Variants that we can determine between, based on our Starting location. East, North and South Variants.
If we are facing South and next to the Entrance is a long Wall we have the South Variant, head south till you find the First Nest, from there go east to find Nest 2 and Nest 3. Seen in Image 3

If we are facing South but the Zone opens up both South and North, then we are in a East Variant. We read all East Variants the same, go east and look for Nest 1, from there look for Nest 2 and then one last time for Nest 3. The diffrence in the Variants is only where the exit is, so after nest 3, head further East and keep an eye out for the Exit Quest Marker. If right next to Nest 3 is a Wall and you see the Quest Marker, then follow the Wall sout / east till you find the opening to Submerged. If there is no Wall next to the 3rd Nest, as in Image 1, head North/East to find the Exit.

The Last Variant, the North one is a bit more Tricky. First we can identify if we are in a North Variant by the Big Rock right above the Entrance. Next The Exit location can be determined based on the distance between the 1st Nest and the Zone entrance. If the 1st Nest is super close and we can not see the 2nd Nest directly. Head North-East for Nest 2 and from Nest 2 head North-West for Nest and the Exit is in the far North-West corner. Layout can be seen in Image 2.
If the 1st Nest is close to the Start and you can see the 2nd Nest Quest Marker at the 1st Nest. Head north for the 2nd Nest, then East for the 3rd and finaly North to find the Exit above Nest 3.

Lastly for the North Exit Variant, the 1st Nest unusualy far away from the Entrance, walk around the Rock above the Entrance. Then head North-East till you see the first Nest Quest Marker. Head to Nest 1, from there head North-East for Nest 2 and finaly North-West again for Nest 3. From Nest 3 head north to find the Exit Quest Marker.
If you find a Variant, not covered / listed here, please Message me.
Waypoint Blocked Western Forest Entrance

The Exit is always on a lower Layer than the Entrance, the correct path has several Slopes/ Ledges down. One Side of the Zone is a Massive Mountain Wall, find the Ledge Side, then follow the downward Slopes.
Prisoner's Gate is a complicated Zone, it is by no means required to learn every Single Layout Variant and its identifiers, unless you are aiming for Sub 3 Hour Campaigns.
Each Zone has two Identifiers, the Direction the Entrance is facing and the Shape of the first Tunnel.
If your Entrance is Facing South-East, always go North-East to find the first Tunnel, then based on the Tunnel shape continue.
If the Tunnel is curved East, head West afterwards. (South Facing Row 1)
If the Tunnel is curved West, head East afterwards.(South Facing Row 2)
If the Tunnel is straigth, check if you can continue Straight, otherwise follow the zone east. (South Facing Row 3)

If your Entrance is Facing North-West, head North to find the Ledge and first Tunel. After the Tunnel check if the Zone continues North, (North-West Facing Row 1) otherwise the 2nd Tunnel is East, like in North-West Facing Row 2.
If your Entrance is Facing North-East, first determine if the Ledge Side is North of the Entrance or South/East of the Entrance.
If the Ledge is South and the Tunnel is also South, then turn East after the Tunnel. (North-East Row 1)
If the Ledge is South and the Tunnel is facing East. The Exit can either be north or south afterwards. Walk East and if the Zone does not open south, head North. Like in North-East Row 2
Otherwise follow Zone South like in North-East Row 3.
If the Ledge is North and the Tunnel is curving East, head West afterwards
If the Ledge is North and the Tunnel is straight, first check the top East Corner of the Zone after the Tunnel, if no 2nd Tunnel is there, check the bottom east Corner and follow the Zone.
Ignore the Blue Arrows on the Immages, I was originaly firmly believing the Waypoint Position in corelation to the first Tunnel was determining the Direction afterwards.

To not fall for fake Tunnles leading to Vaal Zones, during a Tunnel the zone is always slightly angled Downwards. If the Tunnel is even, you are heading for a Vaal Zone. The Vaal Zones are not breaking the Layout Rules, just creating Dead Ends leading away from the Zone after the first Tunnel.
Waypoint Fairgraves Boss Arena Ship Graveyard Cave Entrance Pirate's Treasure (Unique Boss and 2 Tormented Spirits)

Follow the Cliff Side till you see the Ship Graveyard Cave Entrance or the Cavern of Wrath Entrance. If you see the Ship Graveyard Cave, place a Portal near it and search for Cavern of Wrath. If you find Cavern of Wrath first, enter, get WP, exit and search for Ship Graveyard Cave.

Fairgraves will always spawn near the Waypoint, you can also see a Lore Interaction near Fairgraves Arena, exiting from the Ship Graveyard Cave Exit behind the Allflame, will place you at Fairgraves Arena.

The Ship Graveyard Cave Entrance can be anywhere in the Zone, however it is usualy close to the Edge. In 9/10 cases it is near the Cliff Side. Rarely it is near the Coast Side. In most cases you will find the Ship Graveyard Cave before finding the Entrance to Merveils Cavern. Rarely it is after Merveils Cavern in your pathing following the Cliff Side.
To find the Ship Graveyard Cave and Cavern of Wrath efficiently. Follow the Cliffside Wall of the Zone.
There are 3 Layout Groups. It is neat to identify what Variant you are in, to make it easier to understand where the Exits are gona be.

South Extending Zones, which place you facing North, but extend South. The Waypoint is usualy directly visible in these Zones and you can head South paralel to the Cliffside almost imeadiatly. See Examples in South Extending Zone Column.
North-East Entrance Variants, placing the Character facing North-East and North-West Variants placing the Character facing North-West.

If the Ship Graveyard Cave has not been discovered by the time you found the Cavern of Wrath. Get the Waypoint from Cavern of Wrath, then head out. In North-East Variants the Ship Graveyard Cave Entrance is likely along the Cliff Side, but in North-West Variants, expect the Entrance to Ship Graveyard Cave to be Southish.

The Allflame and Exit to Fairgraves Arena are always in a Diagonal Line to the Entrance. The Pathing through the Cave System is a bit more Zig Zag. But keeping the Diagonal Line in mind we just need to determine in which Direction the Zone extends to.
Based on the First 1-2 Turns we have to take to avoid Dead Ends and take Curves, we can determine which direction the Zone faces.
A special rule specific to the South Variant is that the Allflame Room can never be entered from the North. In the South Variant the entrance will always be from the West.
So with those Rules and Patterns in mind. Take the Direcction the Zone forces you, look for Edges to orient the Layout and avoid Dead Ends by keeping the Diagonal Line from Entrance to Exit in mind.
Waypoint Portal Placement Recommendation Secondary Pathing to Flooded Depths
Follow the Zone, place Portal at the Bridge. Or when you see the Flooded Entrance on Minimap, place Portal, then look for the Bridge.
The Layout Variant can be identified based on the Start of the Zone.
Zone Entrance to Waypoint orientation
Waypoint Room Form
Zone opening up South or North

If the Waypoint Room has only one Exit I define it as Funnel Layout, for lack of better Term. If there is no 2nd Room or Passage behind the Waypoint to the East. Head South, to the Bridge. Place a Portal at the Bridge for later. Then head to Ledge. (Image 2) If there is a 2nd Room or Passage behind the Waypoint. The Portal should be placed in the 2nd Section before reaching the Bridge, saving Time later when returning for the Flooded Depths. After that proceed as normal to the Bridge. (Image 1)

If the Zone if opening North, the Exit will be in the North-West Corner of the Zone, place the Portal in the 2nd Section before the Bridge and the Flooded Depths will be on the same Side as the Waypoint was, seen in Image 3 and 4.

If the Zone is opening South, the Bridge can lead South-East or North-East. To differentiate between the 2 Variants, check if the Zone also opens up North-East or just South. If it is just south place the Portal at the Bridge. (Image 5) f the Zone also opens up North-East, be carefull to not fall for the Long Flooded Depths Passage. If you do, place the Portal the moment you see the Entrance to Flooded, then turn around to find the Bridge. See Image 6.
Orange Circle: Boss

The Zone differentiate between Right Sided Entrances placing the Character facing Left and Left Sided Entrance placing the Character facing Right. Overall adding all Layouts together we have the best % of getting through the Zone the fastest if we always go Left / West Side at the Start.
The simple read is, go left, if facing a Ledge, turn around and take the Right / East Side to get to Hailrake.
However with 2 additions to the Rule we can further improve the Layout read.
If you face a Long Gap Ledge, further explained in Major Zone Identifier, continue the Passage, it will be a short Ledge.
If you have a 2 Rocks Layout with a Passage, take the Passage if the 2nd Rock ends, also further explained in Major Zone Identifier.
There are 2 Major Zone Identifier the Ledge and the Rocks.

If the Width of the Ledge is equal to the Distance of the Ledge to the Wall, seen in Image 2 and 3, we know it will be a long Ledge and it is better to turn around. While if the gab between Ledge and Wall is at least double the width of the Ledge, then it will be a short Ledge. You can see an example of this in Image 4.

The 2nd major identifier is specific to the Rocks Layout, we can decide to take the Passage between the Rocks based on the orientation of the 2nd Rock. The 2nd rock either extends West or East, which will also be the direction Hailrake is at. So we want to always go the same direction. If you could go past the Rock, take the Passage, and if the rock leads on West / Left go along the Rock. Seen in Images 7 to 10.
Green Triangle: Support Gem Orange Circle: Boss
Walk East / North East along the Coastline, Hillock is always at the far East End of the Zone.
Ignore all Enemies here, only get the Weapon, Skill Gem, and Support Gem. Kill Hillock for a guranteed Level up to Level 2
Flask Strongbox: can drop Quicksilver Flasks
Check North-East First, if dead End, turn around. Then follow the Outer Wall, this Read is not guranteed to find the Strongbox or be the fastest, but it will lead to the Exit.
Upper Prison has 8 Variants, 2 Variants where the Exit is in the Center and 1 for each Corner. Those 4 are Mirrored for South expanding Layouts and North Expanding Layouts.

Based on the Room(s) connected North-East of the Starting Room we can identify if the Layout is a West Or East Variant. If the North-East Room is a Dead End, the Zone extends West, if it connects to further Rooms, its a East Variant. We can further determine if it is a North or South Variant based on the Edge of the Zone. In North Variants, as an Example. We will find the Southern Edge either imediatly or very quickly by checking the Edge of the Starting Room.

So combining those two we can determine where we have to go. Now we just need to define if the Exit is in a Corner or the Center, also defined as Loop Layouts. In the West Variant of the Loop Layout, we will always be forced to go past the Strongbox, so once you see it before the Exit, you know the Exit is in the Center. In the East Variants, you can in theory skip the Strongbox and walk directly to the Exit. However, unless you know exactly on which rooms you can skip to the Exit and can identify each layout. You will likely see the Strongbox as well before the Exit in the respective Corner. At which point you can determine the Layout and can head to the Exit.
On Corner Layouts the Strongbox is not on the direct Path to the Exit, however you can usualy Spot it during the Pathing and can take the detour if desired.

I highly recommend practicing Upper Prison if you want to improve your Act 1 time. Reading the Zone starts to make Sense once you ran like 20 of them back to back and start seeing the patterns. Then applying the learned in full Act 1 Runs.
Outside the first Floor, the Staircase to the next Floor is always diagonal opposite to the Entrance.

There are always 3 Floors in the Ancient Pyramid. For the first floor, just like on the Ground Floor in Caverns, Check the Corners. Personally I go counterclockwise, but you can also check them clockwise. Once you are on the Second Floor, the Staircase up will be in the diagonal opposite Corner. Same for the third Floor.
Waypoint Abandonend Bandit Camp with Breach Exile Jewellery Stash guarded by 3 Rouge Exiles (Hostile after opening Stash)
Follow the Road

To find Kraitlin's Bandit Camp, simply follow the Road. When you see the Waypoint you can deviate from the Path, to find in the Left corner of the Broken Castle 3 Rouge Exiles guarding a Jewellery Stash. This is optional, but great for improving Gear. There is also a Breach, but I would recommend only going for it, if you can see it from the Road.
Waypoint Secret Door leading to Vaal Skill Damage Recipe
Secret Door is always in the Same room with 2 fallen Rubble Walls, click the 2 small Pillars to open the Door.
For the Cave Part, always take the 2 Bridges West, then move South till you hit the Corner turning East. After that move East till you reach the Entrance with the Waypoint.

From there the Exit can be in any of the 3 Corners of the Zone, generaly Recommend starting checking first the East Corner, then North, then West, however sometimes you can see the Door from a Distance like in Image 3.
Waypoint 2x Stairs that don't lead to the next Floor, instead they have a guranteed Blue Pack.
The Waypoint is always next to the Passage that leads to Chamber of Sins 2. Find the Entrance to the Inner Circular Room, then head to the Passage behind the Waypoint.

Head South-East to find the Top Corner of the Inner Room, if you see the Waypoint, head to the opposite Direction, otherwise follow the Wall around the inner Room till you get into the inner Room or end up beneath the Waypoint. From there head to the Entrance to Chamber of Sins 2.
Trial of Ascendancy Gem Room, containing random Assortment of Act 1 / Act 2 Gems
The Fidelitas Boss Arena location can be determined based on the Position and Direction of the Trial.

In the Trial right after entering, the first Section can be skipped by using Blink Arrow or Lightning Warp in the 1st niche. Stand in the Yellow Circle marked Niche, then aim at the Pillar you can see in the distance.
The final Room before the Walkway to the Fidelitas Boss Arena is always the same, it contains 2 Pillars and 1 Lit Fire Basin.

So the first step in Chamber of Sins 2 is locating the Trial. We always head South-East from the Entrance. If South is a Dead End, we are in the North extending Variant. We find the trial by following the Wall leading to the North-West Corner of the Zone. And the Fidelitas Arena will be in the North-East Corner. The Trial and the Walkway are paralel to each other.
If The Trial is on the East Wall, facing North-East, the Fidelitas Boss Arena will be South and then West from the Trial.

If the Trial is on the Eas Wall, but facing North-West instead. The Fidelitas Boss Arena will be South and then East from the Trial. Carefull to not fall for the Gem Room Dead End which will be either directly connected to the Trial Room Passage or as the first Passage extending East again.

Finally if you don't see a Trial on the east Wall before crossing a Room with 2 Pillars and a lit Fire Basin, in exactly the same Position as the Final Room example above, then both Trial and Exit will be on the West Edge. You will have to move first West, then North-West to find the Trial. After the Trial head South-East till you can move West again, from there go South till you find the Final Room, then head through the Passage to kill Fidelitas.
Waypoint Breach in ruined Cathedral

Crossroads has always a static Layout, the Waypoint is always in the center of the Zone. From there the Exit to Chamber of Sins is to the North-West. Broken Bridge Entrance is North-East of the Waypoint. If you need Exp, you can take the alternative route, marked in the Image above in Yellow, to open the Breach. To the South-East you will always find the Entrance to Fellshrine Ruins.
Waypoint Trial of Ascendancy

Draw a Horizontal Line through the Starting Room, if the Waypoint is below that Line, follow the Opposite Wall of the Waypoint. If the Waypoint is above the Line, follow the Wall behind the Waypoint. That wall will lead to both the Trial and the Entrance to Crypt 2.

If your starting room places you facing South-West, you can either be in the North Exit or West Exit Variant. You can differentiate between the two by the Passage after the Trial. If there is no Passage or the Passage leads West. You are in the West Exit Variant.

The Altar Room is always gona look the Same, big Staircaise leading to the Tombs with the Golden Hand being in the Wall behind it. There are 4 Variations to Crypt, 2 for the East Facing Starting Room and 2 for the South Facing Starting Room.

If the Starting Room Exit is East, you are either in a North or East Variant. Move East, till you either find the Altar Room or notice that the Zone ends East and forces you to move North. If the Zone forces you North, move North along the East Wall to get to the Altar Room.

If the Starting Room Exit is South, we follow the same Principle. Move South till the Zone ends and forces you to move West, or you find the Altar Room. If the Zone forces you West, move West till you find the Altar Room.
3 Stairs, leading to 3 Statues, breaking all 3 will Spawn a Unique Boss before the big Ruin leading to Crypt.
Follow the Road

The road will lead through 3 Walls, after the Third, the big Ruin surrounding the Crypt Entrance will appear. Follow the Road till you are at the final Ruin, then head North-East to enter Crypt. Sometimes the Road splits into two temporarly, when it does make sure to take the Path leading East when it reconnects.
Kill the small Insect Groups to keep up your Quicksilver Flask Charges and Frenzy Charges
Waypoint 3 Ritual
Follow the Waterside East Edge North

Regardless of Starting Position we walk North into the direction the Zone leads to find the Waypoint. Once we found the Waypoint we use the Terrain around it to determine the Layout. If the Layout is beneath the Ledge then we follow the East Edge North, unless the Water Below is fully surrounding the Waypoint from the South, like in Image 4.
In that case and if the Waypoint is East of the Ledge, we stick to the Western Forest Edge of the Zone till we get close to the Entrance to Cavern. (See Image 2-4)
Den Entrance
Follow the Road to get to the Crossroad Entrance.

The Exit to Crossroads will always be at the End of the road. The road can sometimes disapear temporarly. To refind the road, continue the same direction the road ended. In some variations of the zone the den is a bit to far away from the road, to discover it directly.
In the Semi-Linear Variant the Exit will be West in a direct line from the Crossroads Exit. Place a Portal when you see the exit, to return from later. See Den further away, Semi-Linear Road.

In the Curved Road Variant, the road does a 90° turn West, if you do no't see the Den Entrance, but want to go for it later, place a Portal at the 2nd 90° North-East. When you return to the Zone, walk West to find the Den.
Forsaken Bandit Camp with Breach Waypoint
The Broken Bridges can only be crossed with Dash Skills other than Blink. Lightning Warp, Blink Arrow, Flame Dash, Frostblink, and Leap Slam
Follow the Road

The Road in Riverways will always connect Western Forest and Forest Encampment. The Exit to Wetlands will always be North-West of the Waypoint, a worn old path connects the Waypoint to the Entrance, you can see leftovers of the Road still.

If the Waypoint appears super early into the Zone, like Seconds after entering, reset the Zone from the Waypoint. In most Variants the Waypoint appears either in the Middle or towards the Western Forest Entrance. The Reset should save you some time.
Follow the Cliff Side / East Edge of the Zone north to get to the Town.
Great Zone for EXP Catchup, easy to kill Bluepacks with high density.
Vaal Sphere, always in same Room Layout Vaal Altar, can corrupt any Item or Gem
Walk Forward, whenever hitting a Dead End / Edge Turn to the Direction the Zone continues, and continue walking forward.

Vaal Ruins is a bit more complex of a Zone. To identify what Pattern the Zone follows we first need to walk in the Direction the Start lets us. I recommend following the Simple Rule till we identify a Pattern.

The first Pattern we can identify or exclude is the V Pattern, if we walk South for a long distance then hit the South Corner, we know we are in the V Pattern. Alternative if we cannot walk South all the Way into the South Corner, we can exclude the V Pattern.

On the same Step of Identifying or Excluding we can look at the Fast Variant, if we can walk South-West until we see the Vaal Room, we are in the Fast Variant. Otherwise we will hit a Dead End or Zone Edge.
The Spiral Pattern we can identify when we enter the Vaal Room and it is behind the Entrance on the Minimap, but we too East Turn at the Start, we are in the Spiral Pattern.
Finally to differentiate between the diffrent S Patterns, look in which direction the Zone is extending in. The 2nd Turn will always go the opposite Direction then the First Turn.
Follow the Left Wall from the Entrance.

Always go West first at the Entrance, if you can go north, the Zone is the North Variant. If the Zone doesnt let you go West or South after a bit, you spawned at the South Corner and Weaver will be North-East. (See Image 2)
If you can take a long Row of Rooms or Passage West before a second Row of Rooms or Passage south, Weaver's Arena Entrance will be in the South Corner.

If you can only go West and South for few Rooms, like in Image 1. Take the East Passage when you reach the first Corner that only lets you go East. Weaver will be in the North-East Corner of the Zone.
Blackguard Camp at Seal Waypoint Alira's Bandit Camp
Weaver opposite Side of Waypoint from the Road. Alira Same Side, a Pebble/ Small Rock Path leads from the Road to Alira. Blackguard Camp at the End of the Road.

Follow the Road till you get to the Waypoint. From there head to the opposite Side of the Road to find Weaver, there are Spiderwebs at the Forest Edge near the Entrance, use these to find it. If you saw Spiderwebs and they stopped, you missed the Entrance. Alira is on the same Side of the Waypoint, you can follow the road until you see the pebble Path, but it can take longer than just walking to the Edge and running along the Edge till you see Alira or her Arena on your Minimap. After Alira, walk to the West Edge of the Zone, if you find the road again, follow the Road. If you hit the South Corner, walk North-West to find the Camp.
Waypoint & Locked Vaal Ruins Entrance

If you spawn right at the East Edge, the Waypoint will be in the South-West Corner, move North-West to find Oak, from Oak move South and get to the Waypoint. If your spawn is centered Oak can be either close the West Edge, East Edge or in the Center of the Zone. We can simplify the location process a lot.
Move North to find Oak,first check a bit more North-West, if no Oak then check further North-East. Example good to see in Image 1 and 3.
You can spot Oak very well by his Arena, it is the only big Structure in the Zone. if you see any Edges with small ZigZags , it will be Oak's Bandit Camp.
After killing Oak walk East of his Arena Northwards. If you can see the East Edge when walking past Oak's Arena. The Waypoint will be in the North-East Corner.
If you can't see the East Edge, you are either in the Center Oak or West Edge Oak Variant. In both we walk North into North West till we see the Waypoint.

The recommended Path helps Alira for 15% all Elemental Resistances. If you want to help Oak for +40 Flat Life or help Kraitlin for 8% Movement Speed or kill all for 1 Passive Point from Eramir Do the Zone of whom you help last and kill all other first, if you kill all, don't forget to get the Apex in Town.
4 Golden Pages
Traverse the Zone Clockwise

Each Golden Page is in a seperate Alcove filled with Books. This Zone is semi-static. You have a set amount of potential Positions the Golden Pages can spawn in. The Zone is a Square that in the North-West Corner does not connect. It is best to always move clockwise through the Zone and recommended to check the East corner, even if the Path does not directly connect to it. When you get close to an Alcove, if it does contain a Golden Page, the Quest Marker will appear. So there is no need to go into Dead End Alcoves if you do not see a Quest Marker in them.
Waypoint Ribon Spool
Move North-West for the Waypoint. Waypoint is on the First Elevation Layer. Docks Entrance is North of Waypoint and Solaris Temple Entrance is at the end of the River going through the Zone.

The Zone has some set Rules it followes. It always has 3 Layers, The Entrance from Marketplace and Exit to Docks is always on the Ground Layer. The Waypoint is always on the 1st Layer and the Entrance to Solaris Temple is always on the 2nd Layer. Additionaly the Solaris Temple also has a diffrent Floor Tile. Through the Zone goes a River you can either Dash across with Level 10 Movement Skills or find a Bridge to get across. The River originates from a Solaris Statue Fountain. The Statue always points directly at the Solaris Temple Entrance. Lastly the River will always go between the Entrance from Marketplace and the Waypoint.

Given this Ruleset for the Zone. We can very easily navigate it. First move North-East to find both the River, to cross it, and the 1st Elevation Layer to move up. Once you are on the first Layer find the Waypoint and Ribon Spool. From there we know Docks Exit is North to North-West. The Difference here is that on the North-West Variant, we find the North Edge very quickly. Move North first and if you get to the Edge, move East to find Docks, otherwise it will be in a direct Line from the Waypoint. When coming back into Battlefronst to find Solaris Temple 1. Follow the River opposed to its Flow to find the Statue and move from there to Solaris Temple 1 Entrance.
Trial of Ascendancy
After the Starting Room: Move East if you can, move North otherwise.

The Starting Room can face East or West, move throuhg and find the exit. The Trial has to extend North or East. If we always move with that in Mind in the direction the Zone Extends. We can spot the Trial fairly quickly. Follow the rules of the Simple Read. If you can move East, move east and if you can't move East, but can move North move North.
Clarissa Waypoint Movement Speed Recipe next to Apex Exit
Clarissa is always at a Pillar next to the first Staricase to the Docks Area.
Move North-East to get to Clarrisa, then stay at the Upper Part to kill more enemies, dash down to the Town Entrance.
Waypoint Trial of Ascendancy Tolmen, after Piety Fight
Piety and the Trial of Ascendancy can be seen in the Fog, while still undiscovered.

To differentiate between the Diffrent Main Layout Variants, we always check West first. If West is a Dead End, we are in the East Variant. If we instead can move South directly, we are in the South Variant.

If we find the Trial West but Below the Entrance on the Minimap, Piety will be East. IF the Room leading to the Trial was a Linear one, Piety is South East. If the Path to the Trial was through several small Rooms, Piety will be in the North-East Corner.
If it is an East Layout, move North above the Waypoint to find the Trial. If it is at the East Edge of the Zone, Piety will be West of the Trial, otherwise Piety will be East of the Trial.

If the Layout is a West Variant. continue West to see any Identifiers of Piety or the Trial, move to find the Trial. The Book Icon always indicates the Entrance to the Trial. Based on the Trial postion, we can pinpoint Pietys Position. See West Extending Zone Image 1-3.
Essence encased Shipeyard Terror (will only drop an Essence on first Kill) Waypoint Guranteed Blue Pack in every Dead End
You spawn close to a Corner, follow the other Direction of the Wall till you findthe Thaumatic Dust.
The Waypoint, Quest Item and Essence Boss spawn in a Random Corner the Zone. The best way to minimize Time spend in this Zone is to identify the Zone Variant and follow the Correct Edge.
If it is the South Variant, follow the Right Wall from the Entrance South. If it is the North Variant, follow the Left Wall from the Entrance North.
Waypoint Gravicus Boss, Unlocks Level 28 Skill Gems in Town.
Move North-East, Zone is Semi-Static, only difference is Exit being in Line with Gravicus and Waypoint or is facing East.
When entering the Zone a 2nd time to get to Imperial Gardens, Exit is always East of Waypoint.
Waypoint Trial of Ascendancy Cassia & Blight locked Sceptre of God Entrance
Follow the Road. From WP follow Road with Wagons for Tower and North Corner (ofroad) for Trial

Follow the Road till you reach the Waypoint. From there The Library is always North-West. Follow the Road in that Direction to find the Library Entrance. The Entrance to the Sceptre of God is North-East or East of the Waypoint. Follow the Series of Wagons to find the Entrance. The Trial is in the North Corner of the Zone, there is no Road leading to the Trial, however sometimes the Trial Passage connects to either the Library Path or Splits of from the Wagon Road.

Always move North from the Waypoint, if it overlaps with the Wagon Road, take the first Big Passage that splits of the Road. From theere move North if you can, otherwise move East to find the Trial of Ascendancy.
Siosa Waypoint Hidden Candle Lever & Entrance to Archives
TO BE DONE properly

Search for the Waypoint and Siosa, from there look which direction the Zones extends to and find the Hidden Entrance to Archives. The Room with the Entrance is always the same Shape and can only be entered from the South or West. This helps determing it's position.
Waypoint
Follow the Red Carpet
If the first door is facing South, the Exit is in the North-East Corner. If the first door is facing North, the Exit is in the North-West Corner.
In the Big Room with the several Rows of Banks, the Carpet is forking of in the correct Direction. Left for North-East Exit and Right for North-West Exit.

The first Part of Lunaris Temple 2 is a Maze created by a series of Bridges. There are 3 notable Dead End Rooms, Square, Rectangle, and Double Platform. It is recommended to familirize with their Shapes on the Minimap to identify early and avoid.

The Maze has 3 Layers. connected by 3 long staircases. The first and second Layer are always connected by 2 Staircases. So the first Stair does not determine the Layout Direction yet. So to traverse the first and second Layer of the Maze take one Direction and search for the Staircase. IF you find it take the Staircase, otherwise change direction and repeat. Once you have found the 2nd Staircase, the third one will be facing the same Direction as the 2nd one.
You can go clockwise our counterlclockwise, just always stick to the same Pattern.
The second Part of Lunaris Temple is semi-static. It consist of a long Pathway, 2 big Gateways, a Cage Maze and a final Walkway leading to the Piety Fight.

For the first long Pathway look at the Wagons right next to the 3rd Staircase, you can determine the Correct direction based on which side only has one Wagon. If you have a North Layout, the Path will be one Long L Piece, with 1 Turn before you reach the first Gate. The second Gate in a North Layout will always be in a direct Line from the first Gate. After that follow the Walkway 2 Stairs up to fight Piety.

On a South Variant, the Path will take few more turns, but will also end on the first Gate. After the First Gate the 2nd Gate will be in a adjacent Direction from it. The rooms leading up to the 2nd Gate will force the Player to walk in a U-Pattern. If the Stairs in the first Part faced East, then the 2nd Gate will also face East, so move East on the U-Pattern. And if the Stairs in the first Part faced West, then the 2nd Gate will also face West, so move West on the U-Pattern.
Waypoint
If West of Entrance is Water, Zone Extends north, otherwise Zone Extends West. Search for the Arch to get to the WP From the WP to find Battlefronts, follow the East Wall.
Marketplace has at least 8 Layout Variants. Need further Research to find more. Based on Tunnel and the Terrain after the Waypoint we can determine where the Exit is.
Waypoint
Traverse the Zone Clockwise and stay in the inner Square of the Zone

Sceptre of God consist of 3 Floors, the Exit is always in one of the Corners, on the first Floor it has to be in the North-East or South-East Corner.' After that it can be in any Corner, except the one the Entrance to that Floor is in. Choose a Direction and check the first Corner. Stay in the inner Area of the Zone, if you aproach a Corner and do not get the Door Icon on the Minimap, the Staircaise to the next Floor won't be in that Corner. Check the Corner Clockwise or Counterclockwise
The final Floor has both a Waypoint and the Staircase to the Upper Sceptre of God in its Corners.

My 'vibe' Read of the Zone is to always move into the direction the Stairs places me, this works often enough that it feels correct. Exception is that the Direction I placed in does not have a Door, then I check the other Direction first.
Waypoint Sewer Blockage 3 Busts
Big Room after WP, 3rd Bust Left of Exit, Small Room after WP, 3rd Bust South.
Leading up to the Waypoint the Zone is fairly Linear, with 1 Dead End we have to check. It can either contain the Bust or be just a Dead End. After the Waypoint we can easily read the Zone.
If the Room behind the Bust is a big open Room, the 3rd Bust will be West of the Exit.
If the Room behind the Bust is a Linear Coridor and South of the WP is the 2nd Bust, the third Bust will be in the South-East Corner, with a Connection to the North. Where you can get to the Exit.
If the 2nd Bust is in a Small Room, after a Cross Corridor. The 3rd Bust should be collected first, it will be in a Dead End Room in the South-East Corner.
Go into the Direction that is not the Dead End at the Start
There are 2 Variant Group that contain 3 Sub Variants each. West Facing Entrances and East Facing Entrances.
For Wst Facing Entrance, the exit will be either in the North-East or North-West corner of the Zone.
To differentiate between the Sub Variants, we go with a Checklist.

Always check East at the Start, if it has the Long Dead End either directly or when checking further East. The Exit will be in the North-West corner, but to get there we need to head South-West first till we can move North-West. Like in West Facing Entrance Image 1.
If there is no Long Dead End East, but the Eastern Edge of the Zone, then the Exit is North-West, but we can go there directly. Like in West Facing Entrance Image 2.
Finaly if the Zone extends East instead and we can continue east. The Exit is North-East. Move East till you hit the East Corner, then move North.
For the East Facing Entrance, we can simplify the Ruleset to get to the Crematorium Entrance.

Always move East till you hit the East Corner. If you walked along the East Edge, the Exit will be North from the East Corner. Follow the Easern Edge North till you find the Exit. If you could have walked South-East at the Start, the Exit is in the East Corner.
Waypoint

Walk forward till you hit a Wall and see the Zone is not further Extending in that direction. Turn in the direction the Zone is extending to and walk forward again. If you hit a Wall, but see the Zone is further extending in that direction, walk around the Wall and walk further forward.

Follow the Simple Read till you get to the Waypoint. based on the Waypoint Position, or rather the Corner it is in, we can determine the general Direction of the Exit. If the Corner of the Waypoint is pointing East. the Exit is in the South-East Corner. If the Waypoint is pointing North The Exit is either in the North Corner or North-West Corner, check the North Corner first, otherwise move North-West to find the Exit to Solaris Temple 2.
Waypoint Lady Dialla Quest NPC Flat Fire Recipe in Map Device Room, Entrance next to Dialla
Follow the Red Carpet
Solaris Temple 2 has 6 Variants, 4 Skipless and 2 where a small Variation creates a Skip.
At the Start always move West to check for the Small Skip.
If you can dash across the Gap you are in the Small Skip Nort Variant. Follow the Passage North till it curves East, then follow the Zone east till it curves North again. Move North to find Dialla.
Otherwise Head into the Direction the Zone is extending to, either North or South. The Variant can be determined once reaching the next Corner.

If the Zone extends North it is either the West Layout or the North Layout. When able to move East. It is either a Dead End and you are in the West Variant. Follow the Zone West along the North Edge. Otherwise it extends East and you can follow the Zone North along the East Edge

If the Zone extends South it is either the East or South Layout. The South Layout does not curve East. So if you have a forced Pathing East you know you are in the East Layout. Follow the Zone east along the East Edge. Otherwise follow the Zone South. It will do a U-Turn before you can see the Dialla Area. If you can see Dialla or the Book Icon on your Minimap while moving South the South Skip is available. To do the Skip stand at the West Edge and use Blink Arrow / Lightning Warp to dash across the Gap.
Caged Scion (First Playthrough only)
The upper Sceptre of God follows the same Layout Rules as the Sceptre of God, with some additions.

The Side-Passages or Cornes can be replaced with Balconies. A Corner Balconie can never be the Corner containing the Staircase to the next Floor. The Upper floor is a lot more rundown, sometimes there are broken Walls, if two of those align or one and the Room after has a railing, it can be dashed through with a Lvl 10 Movement Skill.
The Third Floor is a Static Layout, you always walk to the center then move North-East past the Cage to find the Entrance to the Rooftop.
Waypoint Dead Ends to West/East have Blue Packs at the End

Zone has 2 paralel Walkways, divided by the Water in the middle. Each Side can have Dead Ends splitting of East or West. Those Dead Ends contain a guranteed Blue Pack, if you need Experience, Aqueduct is a great Source.
If the Walkway ends, there is always a Bridge crossing over the Water to the other side.
Lever to activate the Portal

Move North, in the middle of the Zone is a long Bridge. After the Bridge stick to the East Edge till you get past the Encampent with the Crafting Recipe. When the Path curves West, move West to activate the Lever and enter the Slave Pens.
Move West if you can
Otherwise Move North if you can
If neither is possible Move East
If hitting a Dead End turn around and repeat at top
The above simple Rule applies to all Layouts with one Exception, sometimes at the Start you have to move South first, then a long East Passage, before the above Simple Rule applies again.
Piety and locked Passage
There are 5 Belly of the Beast 2 Variants, to differentiate between them move west till you hit a Dead end.
If you start North and the Tunnel face South, you are in the North Start Variant.
If you directly move into a Dead End you are in the 1 Tunnel Variant. Move North till you can no longer move north, then follow the Passage and always move North if you can again.

If you move past 1 Tunnel and the next one is not directly next to it. (compare 2 Long Tunnels with 2 Tunnels or 2 Mini Tunnels Space between the 2 Tunnels) Move North through the second Tunnel till you hit a T Cross Section, from there move East whenever you can and if hitting a North/South T Section, move North.

If you have 2 Tunnels but the North part of the 2nd Tunnel is the same Distance as the West between Tunnel 1 and Tunnel 2 you are in the 2 Mini Tunnels Variant. Move North through the Second Tunnel, from there move East when you can, otherwise move North.
Finally if you have 2 Tunnels close together, move North-East after you leave the 2nd Tunnel till you hit the East Edge T Section, from there move North and follow the Path.
Waypoint

The Final Room always has 2 Entrances, one from the South and one from the West. The Zone always has a long Path and a Short Path to the Entrances of the Final Room. To find the Shortest Path we differentiate between North and South Variants.
For the South Variant there is a simple Read
Stick to the opposite Edge of the Direction the first Passage takes.

To extend on that Simple Read, if the First Passage goes West, we want to stick to the East Edge, avoiding Dead Ends. We can assume if a Passage is a Dead End East, by knowing that we have to walk till the South Edge before turning East. But if the First Passage goes East, we want to stick to the West Edge and take the first Tunnel West to find the Exit.

For the North Variant we can determine the Sub Variant based on the First couple Rooms. If the First Rooms do a almost Loop and we end up in a Room right above the Entrance, stick to the West Edge and move North till you find the South Entrance to the Final Room. If the first Couple Rooms only go South, move West once you able to and only start moving North once you can hit the West Edge. To differentiate between the 2nd North Variant and the South Variants. We know that the North Variants takes at least 2 Rooms South, while the South Variants always go 1 Room South and then curve either West or East.
Daresso's Dream can be a bit Tricky, but there does exist a Simple Read.
If you can move East move East, otherwise move South till you can move East Again, when you hit the East Edge, move North.
With a few Exceptions, the Simple Read does get you through the Zone.
The first Exception is the U Pattern Variant. If the First and Second Room both only have 1 Exit, then in the Third Room move West. This is the only Variant where the Exit is West.

In any other Variant the Exit is in the North Corner of the Zone at the East Edge. We move North till we hit the First Room, from there we move East till we hit the East Edge or a 2 Path Room, on the 2 Path Room always go South, then resume moving East.
The Last Exception is the Maze into Maze Variant, where we have to walk into a Dead End before realizing we reached the East Edge, move back out of it then turn North.
Legion Monolith in the middle of the Zone
The first thing you will see of the Voll Boss Arena is in 9/10 Cases the Book Icon on the Minimap. Once you see the Icon move in that Direction.
To figure out the general Layout Variant you are in, check the West Wall at the Spawn,
if you have a long Passage before reaching the Big Pillars, do not walk past them, instead move West to find the Boss Arena.
if you have a open Zone, but a Big Blockage when walking South-East, walk South along the Hole till you find Voll Arena.
if you have a open Zone with no Big Hole or Small Passage into open Zone before Pillars, just walk South-East till you find the Book/Voll.
Waypoint and 4 Socket & Link Recipe 3 Bosses blocking the last Corridor and Boss Arena
Grand Arena is, once understood how it Works, a very simple Layout.

It consists of a Series of Arenas, connected by Corridors. It starts linear, but after Arena 2 there is a Split in the Road. The wrong Path either leads in a Dead End or an additional Arena to path through.
So the way we go through the Zone is as follows:
Follow the Corridor if it does not split
In an Arena cross it directly to find the next Corridor Entrance
When the Plath Splits take the North or West into North Option.
The Final Arena contains 3 Unique Mini-Bosses we have to kill before we can enter the Final Corridor and Boss Arena.
Waypoint 3 Mini Bosses Piety
This Zone is a Static Layout, the only random Part in this Zone is which Boss is where. One Boss is always East of the Waypoint and two Bosses are West of the Waypoint.
The only thing to add to the Simpel Read here is that Logging for American Servers or Portaling for others after Killing Boss 1 and Boss 3 is faster than walking. It also refreshes your Flasks.

Kaom's Dream is a linear Zone, as in one Path, though it is a very curved S-shaped Path. The Exception are 1-2 Skips available at the Lava Falls. That said, not every Layout Variant has those available. Most have 1 Skip in the middle of the Zone. Rarely you get the Variant that has 0 Skips and even more rarely one that has 2 Skips.
You can identify the double Skip Layout by its open Starting Area and late Path splitting of to the East.
There are 2 Ways to do the Skip.

Stand in the 2nd Corner of the Right Side of the Lava Fall Zoom all the way in Aim at the upper Part of the Right Border of your first Buff / Aura / Minion Use Blink Arrow / Lightning Warp / Leap Slam
Waypoint

Kaom's Stronghold similar to Kaom's Dream is a linear Zone. Again as in only has 1 Path to take that you want to follow. Almost all Variants can be summarized in the Snaking Pattern. However if the Big Rock you walk past is on the East Side then you can walk straigth North. This is the only variant that spawns a second Staircase to the 2nd Layer.
If you can move North-West, otherwise follow the Zone.
Deshret's Spirit
Mines 2 can be determined based on the Layout and the general Path the Zone takes. If the Zone extends South, follow the Path till you see Deshret Spirit, free here, then continue.

Deshret might be in a Dead End East or South. Just Follow the Path along the Outer Edge of the Zone till you see the Quest Icon. Knowing roughly where the Exit is helps with avoiding Dead Ends. If you hit the South Edge without finding the Exit, then the Exit is in the East Corner.
If the Zone extends North, follow the Path, if the Zone quickly ends South and you can only move North stick ot the East Edge of the Zone to find Deshret.
If the Zone instead continues South for a Bit, stick to the South Edge till you find Deshret, then stick to the West Edge.
Cradle of Purity, interact with to start Kitava Fight Lilly, to travel to Part 2 Act 6 Town
Move North-East

In the Act 5 Variant of Cathedral Rooftop, normaly you can always move through the Center of the Rooftop north-east. Very Rarely the Zone generates in a Way you have to take the Walkway east or west if the middle is blocked.
Waypoint Banon (after killing Innocence). Talk to him to unlock as a Armour & Weapon Town Vendor
Always stick to the Outer Wall of the Zone
Chamber of Innocence has a somewhat Static Layout, they Key Difference between the Variants is in the East Part of the Zone. When the Rooms connect South to the Boss Arena.

You can identify when to move South based on the first elevated Section that cuves South. If the only way to continue is the Passage South, head South to find the Boss Room. Otherwise move West till you get the next Passage South, then that is the Correct Passage to the Boss Room.
After killing Innocence a 2nd Exit opens that places you near the Waypoint.
Each Elevated Section of this Zone contains a guranteed Blue Pack. Great Zone to powerlevel or catch up on Experience. Up to Level 41 on a Solo Run.
Miasmeter Justica Casticus, dropping Eyes of Zeal and unlocks Gate behind him to exit to Oriath Square

Control Blocks has 2 Variants, we can quickly deduce which Variant we are in at the Start. In the 2 Vertical Trench Variant we are forced to move a U Pattern at the Start, while the 1 Horizontal Trench Variant has a Series of Room moving North.

In the 2 Vertical Trench Variant we want to take the first opportunity moving East after the U Pattern. Dash into the Trench and walk out at the Stairs East. Then take the next opportunity to go East again to be able to move North and collect the Miasmeter. From there we move East till we reach the 2nd Trench. Walk the Stairs down and dash out at the broken Fence. Continue South till we have another opportunity to move east. Kill Casticus and follow the Path to reach the exit.

In the 1 Horizontal Trench Variant we move North till we are forced to enter the first trench to continue. Exit it directly with a Dash and continue North to collect the Miasmeter. From there we can move through the Zone similar to the 2 Vertical Trenches Variant with the exception of entering the 2nd Trench from the North. The 1 Horizontal Trench Variant has one noticable Skip, if you do not need the Miasmeter or prefer to collect it later. You can dash through the Wall and Blockage at the inner Curve End of it with a Blink Skill.
Use any Blink Skill at a Broken Gate to Dash through. Works both up and down.

Position yourself directly under the Gap. If its Horizontal into Vertical Trench its at the West Side and if its Vertical into Horizontal Trench its at the East Side. Aim slightly above your player above the BLockage (still inside the Yellow Circle) to dash over it.
Waypoint Locked Templar Courts Door
Move North-West till you get past the Bridge, then move West at the next Crosssection and continue North-West till you reach the Door.
Tomb of the First Templar Level to unlock Passage to Entrance

There are 2 Ossuary Variants, both Looping back to the Entrance. To differentiate between the 2. Check North, if the double Bridge is there it is the North Variant. Otherwise you can't move north and the the zone loops South.
Follow along the Zone along the Inner Edge / Wall to find the Tomb of the first Templar.
After the Tomb you can log/portal if your Loadscreen is fast enough, otherwise use the lever and leave the zone via the entrance.
Waypoint 3 Kitava Torments 2 Hidden Keys in White Chest Vault Door
Choose Clockwise or Counterclockwise, Run the Zone along the Outer Edge in the choosen direction.

The Quest Items are in the North, East and South Corner of the Zone. the middle of the Zone is not directly crossable. You have to move along the Edges. The Vault leads to a Room with a Chest contianing a couple Rare Items and Gold Piles(Random Loot), to open the Vault you have to find 2 Keys hidden in a random White Chest in the Zone, this is not worth your time. Recommended to ignore.
After the Third Quest Item, move back to the Waypoint or Die to Respawn in Town(Softcore only)
Waypoint Blood Fountain (to place Portal at)
Ruined Square is a static Layout, it will always look the same.
To get from the Entrance to the Waypoint, follow the Zone in a S Pattern.
The Bloodfountain is in a straight West Passage from the Waypoint.
North-East of the Bloodfountain is the Rooftop Entrance
South of the Bloodfountian you will always find the Reliquary Entrance.
Waypoint Overseer Krow to unlock Town Entrance
Always stick to the Left Wall from the Start

Move along the West Edge of the Zone South till you see the Fence Wall highlighted in the Images above. At that point move East till you find the next opening South, take it and move west again till forced to go north, at which point you can kill OVerseer Krow to get access to Town.
Proper Image will be added soonTM
Waypoint

The Exit to Chamber of Innocence is paralel to the Entrance from Oriath Square. To get to the Exit we follow the Inner Wall of the Zone East till we get to the Courtroom. After that we move east till we get to the same height as the Entrance andm ove North to find the Exit to Chamber of Innocence.

Torched Courts is a reverse of the Templar Courts. we do want to traverse it a bit diffrently though. For the first Section the Goal is to move East. Sometimes the Rooms force you to path South, sometimes North to get further East. follow the Rooms till you get to the Courtroom. Now the Goal is to move West. The best way I found is to try and navigate through the Corridors. We move a Corridor West, then a Corridor North and repeat till we find the Exit to Ruined Square.
That the Exit and Entrance are still paralel to each other still aplies.
Waypoint 2 Pillars to activate the Beacon Beacon William to travel to Brine King's Reaf

Move North and follow the North Edge till you find the Passage into the open Beach Area, walk North-East till you either find the Ramp to the Lighthouse or Beach, if you find the Beach first, the Lighthouse is usuuale North of you. From the Ramp move further North and do the Pillar Puzzle (Move the Pillars to the Beacon by standing in their Range), after activate the Beacon and talk to William to travel to the Brine King's Reaf
Waypoint
Follow the East Edge
There are 3 Variants, to find the Boss Arena do the following: Walk South-West
If the Zone continues West, walk South-West till you see the Book Icon on the Minimap, then walk North to find the Boss Arena.
If the Zone ends West and forces you South
Walk South till you see the Book Icon on the Minimap
If the Book Icon is early, then the Boss Arena is in the North-East Corner. Continue South along the East Edge till the Zone lets you move East. Then move North-East to find the Boss Arena.
Otherwise the Boss Arena is in the South-East Corner. Move South till the Zone opens up for the Second Time East, then move East.
Flag Chest
Follow along the East Edge
Cavern of Anger in Act 2 has 3 distinguishable Layouts.
If the Zone extends East, stick to the South Edge and move South-East along it.
If the Zone extends North, check the Stairs room you have to walk through. If the stairs face West, the Exit is North of the Stairs Room. Move North-East till you see the big open Room, then North.
Otherwise, if the Stairs face East, move North into North East to find the Exit in the North-East Corner.
Waypoint

While not exactly the same behaviour as the Act 1 Coast. The major rules of the Zone still apply. The Exits and Waypoint are on the Base Layer of the Zone and both Handgun and Long coast Variants still exist.
The major difference to Act 1 is that we now have both Movement Speed and Movement Skills available to us. Shortening the way we run the Zone.
Identify the direction the Zone extends and outside of the special Variants, move in a direct Line in that direction.
Tukohama Boss Arena

Karui Fortress is a static Layout, it will always be the same. Move East at the Start till you find the Entrance to Tukohama Boss Arena. After the Fight exit through the North Entrance and move East again till you can move North to find the Exit to Ridge.

Karui Fortress is based on the Fetid Pool Layout from Part 1 Act 1. A Zone we do not enter during a optimized Act 10 Run. Fetid Pool / Karui Fortress is a circular Zone around a Lake. Karui Fortress is static, so we can always run it the same Way. The Exit to the Ridge is only unlocked, once you kill Tukohama, it is a forced Boss Fight.
Waypoint Trial of Ascendancy

Follow the Right Wall from the Waypoint till you find the Trial. After the Trial either backtrack back to the Exit to Shavronne's Tower or continue to follow the right wall if you have not found the Exit yet.
Lower Prison is the first Zone that deviates from mirroring its Act 1 Version. While we do have a Trial of Ascendancy here and always check the East Corner first, we have to read the Zone diffrently.
Check the Zone for the following Identifiers:
You can see the Exit to Shavronne's Tower from the Entrance and Waypoint. We are in the Loop Layout and will find the Trial before the Exit.
You see the Lever from the Trial through the Wall when we move South, we need to move North-West till we find a Passage leading South, walk past the Exit to Shavronne's Tower to find the Trial.
The Zone continues East after the first Room East of the Waypoint, follow the North Edge to find the Trial,
If the Trial is in a Small Room with no further Exit, backtrack till you find a Passage leading further East, Exit is in the East Corner.
If the Room with the Trial Entrance continues East, it connects to the Exit in the East Corner.
No identifiers, Trial is in the South Corner, the Zone will either Split of East or West. The Exit to Shavronne's Tower is in the Split of Direction.
Further identifiable by the direction of the Trial Entrance. If Trial is facing North or East the Exit is East. Otherwise its West.
locked Entrance to Karui Fortress Dishonoured Queen

The Dishonoured Queen is always at the East Edge of the Zone at the former Submerged Passage entrance. Move East till you hit the Edge, then South/North to find the Submerged Entrance, highlighted by Nessa at the end of the Submerged Entrance. Mud Flats got a lot more simplified from its Act 1 Version. We only need to differentiate between East and North Varians. As we can apply the Simple Read to the East and South Variant.

The North Variant we can still identify the same as in Act 1 Versions. We always spawn with the Rock above the Entrance and past it is open Zone. For there move North-East till you hit the Round Rock. At the Rock move North to find the Dishonoured Queen. After killing the Queen move South-West to find the Entrance to Karui Fortress.

(Good Example is Image 4) After exiting the Boss Arena, leave the Sidezone and then move in a direct Path into the Direction the Road took.
Waypoint
follow the Right Wall from the Start
Ridge has 2 Variants, one where you enter the Zone from the East Corner and one from the South-West Corner.
You can directly tell which variant you are in by the position of the Waypoint to the Zone Entrance.
The East Variant has the Waypoint West of the Entrance and the West Variant East of the Entrance.

In the East Variant follow the Zone till the Zone curves West. From now till you hit the West Edge of the Zone. Indicated by a curve North. Move West, ignore all North or South Entrances. Same for the West Variant, just that you follow the Zone East after the first Curve East. You know you are walking the correct Passage when you move past Wheels on top of Spikes.
Waypoint
Follow the Road At the Waypoint the Pebble Path leads to Wetlands At the blockage head South for the Exit to Souther Forest

Part 2 Riverways in Act 2 is almost a reverse Run of its Part 1 Version, with the Exception that instead of entering the Town, the Entrance is blocked and a new Entrance directly to Southern Forest is south of the Entrance.
Follow the Left Wall from the Entrance of each Floor

Shavronne's Tower consist of 4 Floors and the Rooftop as the Boss Arena. The Exit of each Floor will always facing North-West or North-East. The final Floor Exit will always be a small Walkway leading to a Ladder.
The Zone is overal linear as in there is usualy just 1 Path to take. However sometimes the Zone fakes with Dead Ends, to avoid those follow the Simple Read for the Ground Floor.

Then from the 2nd Floor onwards, we can identify the correct direction the Exit to the Next Floor has to be. The Floors get placed in a Line on the Minimap, the direction the Room is to the previous Room is the Direction the next Exit will be. For Example if the the 2nd Room is East of the 1st Room. Move East in 2nd + Room.
Waypoint
Move East till you hit the Big Wall at the East Edge, then South

Southern Forest consist of a Series of Island connected by small Bridges, if you have a Lvl 10 Movement Skill you can skip across from one Island to another (bigger Gaps only with Blink Arrow / Leap Slam / ) without having to find the Bridge. Once you have reached the Mountainside head South East along the Mountainside. Ignore the first passage North, it would have lead to the former Town Entrance, now blocked. In the South-East Corner of the Zone is the Cavern of Anger Entrance.
Storage Chest
Go West, if facing a Ledge, turn around and take the East Side to get to the Storage Chest.
Continuing the Trend Tidal Island too follows the Rules of it's Act 1 Version in a simplified Manner.
We always go West first, turn around on Ledges with same Distance between wall as Width and take Ledges with long Distance to the Wall. However on Rock Passages I have only found continue Variants.
Full clear the Zone, just make sure you have discovered the full Minimap.
East to West to East is faster than following edge and clearing around.

The Twilight Strand of Part 2 Act 6 is starting a Trend of Zones being very similar to their Part 1 Versions. With most differences being visualy, like the time of the day or different Enemie Types settling in the Zone.

Western Forest in Part 2 is a direct Reverse Run of Western Forest in Part 1, just that we do not need to clear any Sides here.
Follow the Left Wall till you find the Boss Arena Entrance

If you follow the West Edge, you will find a broken Waypoint and after the Boss Arena at some point. However sometimes the Boss Arena is at the North Edge, this Variant can be identified by the River forming the South Edge extending North while curving East.

Move along the West Edge

Move along the West Edge North-East, if the Zone curves East before you can move North again, you are in the Curved Variant. Stick to the now Inner Edge and move West once available. After the Waypoint move South whenever you can, otherwise West.
If the Zone lets you move North-East till you reach the Waypoint, continue North-East along the West Edge.
Waypoint Map Device Silk Locked Entrance to Chamber of Sins 2

Zone is exactly the same as in Act 2. Just locked Chamber of Sins 2 Entrance
Walk South,East,South to see the Circle Room through the Wall.

If you do not see the Waypoint, move East to find the Passage, rarely East is the Dead End.
Trial of Ascendancy Hidden Door to Den
The Chamber of Sins in Act 7 do not follow the same Pattern as the Chamber of Sins 2 of Act 2.
Walkway and Exit to Den can be determined based on the Trial Position and the first couple Rooms.
If the South Room at the Start is a Dead End, move in a North West North Pattern through the Rooms till you find the Trial. From there stick to the West Edge to find the Walkway.

If the Room below the Start Room forces you to path West then ends in another Corner that forces North, the Trial is along the West Edge and the Exit is in the North Corner. Follow the North Edge, but pass the First Room North.
If the Zone extends South walk through the Rooms till you reach the Pillar and Basin Room
If you can see the Trial the Walkway is in the South Corner of the Zone
If you can not see the Trial, the Trial is West of the Room and the Walkway is in the East Corner, but the connection goes over the South Corner.
This skip is more fancy than efficient, it saves a couple Seconds at most. Stand at the broken Table and aim above the broken Gate with Blink Arrow / Lightning Warp / Leap Slam.

Crossroads in Part 2 is following the same Pattern as it did in Part 1 with the Exception of us entering from Broken Bridge and that Old Fields is blocked of.
Waypoint Trial of Ascendancy Sarcophagus Container of Sin

The first Part of this Zone follows the same Rules as it's Act 2 Version. Draw the Line and follow the Opposite Wall of the Waypoint, if it is below, and the Wall behind the Waypoint, if the Waypoint is above the Line.
To enter the second Part of the Zone you need to open the Sarcophagus. The Sarcophagus Room always looks the same, just from a diffrent Angle, you can identify it at the Corner Pattern.
In the North and East Variant, you walk past the Sarcophagus Room to find the Trial. While in the the South and West Variant, you have to continue follow the Wall to find it.
The Container of Sin in the 2nd Part is always in a Diagonal Opposite to the Entrance. Follow one Edge till you hit the Corner, then turn and move in the Direction the Zone continues.
Waypoint
Den has 3 Variants all easily identifiable based on their Starting Directions.
In all Variants follow the direction the Zone extends to and at the first Intersection turn 90° Right and continue in the new Direction.
If the starting Direction is North-West you have to do another 90° Turn, but Left this time. So it would be North-West into North-Est into North West, then you see the Exit.
If the starting Direction is South-East you take another Right Turn. So it would be South-East into South-West into North-West.
And if the starting Direction is South-West you just continue North-West, So its South-West into North-West.

Sanctum Entrance

Early along the West Edge
Late along the West Edge
South-West Corner
Center of the Zone near the West Edge
