First Floor: Follow the Zone. Second Floor: Exit is Diagonal Opposite End to the Entrance.

Temple of Decay 1 has 2 Floors, the first Floor is a direct Path with some Dead Ends splitting of. Move South-East till you enter a Big Square Platfrom, from there only 1 Bridge leads further. Walk in the direction the Bridge forces you till you hit a Corner, then move in the direction the Corner forces you into.
The 2nd Floor is in the Shape of an 8 or Infinity Symbol. Choose either Wall and follow along the Outer Edge of the Zone till you find the Entrance to Temple of Decay 2.

Temple of Decay 2 has 3 Floors + Boss Room. Floor 1 and 2 behave like the 2nd Floor of Temple of Decay 1, with the Exception that 2 of the 4 Bridges on the Big Zentral Platform are broken. There are always 2 opposing intact Bridges and 2 opposing broken Bridges. Flame Dash / Blink Arrow / Leap Slam / Lightning Warp can dash across the broken Bridges.

The direction the Stair faces is the Direction with the intact Bridge. Move in that Direction till you reach a Corner, then turn and move the Direction the Zone extends to, to cross the 1st Bridge. If you do not have one of the above mentioned Movement Skills, walk straigth through the Platform to cross the 2nd intact Bridge and once hitting a corner turn to find the Staircase to the next Floor. If you have a Dash Skill that can cross the broken Bridges, it is faster to dash over the Broken Bridge direct next to the one you just crossed. Then repeat the same Directions you moved to get to the first Bridge.
Waypoint

Move North-West If you hit a Wall, walk around it westwards and continue North-West If the Wall extends more than one Screen North-West, once it has a opening, move East and walk East / South-East to find the Waypoint.
While the Simple Read can get you through Vaal City, it will take a lot longer on 2 Variants of the Zone.
To properly identify the Variant you are in we look at the First Wall we face.

If the Wall is in form of a Cliff right at Zone Start, you are in the Cliff Variant. Move North-East along the Cliff till you see the Big Wall, you should also be able to see the Waypoint on the Minimap. Move East along the Wall and once you can move North again, move North-West past the Wall to find the Waypoint.

If you face a Short Wall shortly into the Zone, but can see the Left End of the Wall, move North-West till you reach the Cliff or see the Long Wall. Move West around the Wall and once you can move North again, move Nort-East to find the Waypoint.

If you face a Long Wall shortly into the Zone, one where you can not see the Left End of it. Move West till you can move past the Wall, then head North-West again till you reach the Long Wall. Move further North-West along the Long Wall till it stops and you can move East. Move East into South-East to find the Waypoint.

Finaly if you reach a Short Wall several Screens into the Zone, but can see the Left End of the Wall. Move past it then you imedieatly face the Long Wall, move East till you can move past it, then head North-West to find the Waypoint.
Waypoint Trial of Ascendancy

Similar to Solaris Concourse in Act 8 we are entering Bathhouse via the Hidden Underbelly, placing us at a initialy unknown Point in the Zone. However we can quickly identify where we are at. To reenter the Zone place a Portal in the 1st Room after the Entrance.

If our Starting Room is facing East, we are in the South Spawn, the Exit is straight North-East and the Trial is in the North-West Corner. We have to travel through the Middle Room with Hector Titucius to get there. From the Trial the Exit to High Gardens is in the North Corner.

If our Starting Room is facing West, we are in the North-East Spawn. The Exit is South along the East Edge from the Room and the Trial is North. The Exit to High Gardens is West from the Trial along the North Edge.
Otherwise our Room is facing South and we need a 2nd Indicator to identify the Layout.
If we see the Levers of the Trial East of the Starting Room we are in the 2nd North-East Variant. Exit to Lunaris Concourse is South-East and the Exit to High Gardens is West.

If we see the Hector Quest Indicator when moving South, we are in the North-West Variant. The Exit to Lunaris Concourse is East. The Trial is West and the Exit to High Gardens is North through the Hector Main Room.
Finally if we have no Indicator the Layout is the South Spawn and behaves like the East Facing Room South Spawn, with the Exception that we can turn West beforfrom the Portal to safe couple Seconds.
Waypoint (after Doedre Kill)
Doedre's Cespool has 3 Variants, we can identify the Variant we are in after 1-3 Rooms. Always go across the first Bridge then go West into the Curve.

If there is a Room splitting of West of that Room, it is the West Variant, stick to the West Edge of teh Zone and move South till you see the Room with the Arena Entrance. It has always the same Shape, just a diffrent orientation.
Otherwise head into the next Room.
If you can continue South along the West Edge, it is the South Variant.
Otherwise the Zone forces you to move east and it is the East Variant.
With sticking to the West Edge we have a longer Pathing in the East Variant, but better Pathing in the South and West Variant.
Waypoint Hidden Underbelly Grate Entrance
Grain Gate consist of several Zones and Indoor Areas connecting them. While most Indoor Areas are Dead Ends, some connect one Zone to the next one. These are highlighted by Corpses next to them.
If you enter the Zone from the West of the Waypoint, the first Indoor Passage is North of the WP and both the Hidden Underbelly Entrance and Gemling Legion are in the 2nd Zone.
If you enter the Zone south of the Waypoint, the first Indoor Passage is West of the Waypoint and the Gemling Legion is in the 3rd Zone while the Hidden Underbelly Entrance is in the 2nd Zone.
The Gemling Legion can be pinpointed by the Book Icon on the Minimap.

After the Gemling Legion is dead we want to search for the Underbelly Entrance. It can be anywhere in the 2nd Zone of the Area. You can spot it based on the Crane next to it and the Ground covered by rusted Metal.
The correct Gates are always identifiable by a Black Guard corpse next to it
Statue of the Sisters, starts the Bossfight
Move North-East in the middle of the Bridge till the Door to the Boss Arena

Harbour Bridge is a Linear Static Layout, the South Side is in Nighttime, while the Northside is in Daytime. Move North-East from the Lunaris Concourse Entrance till you see the Door Icon on the Minimap or Night turns to Day, enter the Boss Arena.

Hidden Underbelly got added in 3.25 and is part of the new optimized ACt 8 Pathing. Skipping Imperial Fields, almost all of Solaris Concourse and first Entrance of Harbour Bridge, while also saving Time in Town combining all Passive Point Collects in one Step.

In the Hidden Underbelly stick to the West Edge from the Start and head South. If the Curved tunnel into the T Section appears West, the Solaris Concourse Entrance is North of the Split and Bathhouse Entrance is South of the Split.
While if the Curved Tunnel is South of the first Area, then head South for the Solaris Concourse Entrance and East for the Bathhouse Entrance.
Follow the Zone

High Gardens is a Long snaking Path, stick to the Lower Layer, it has more Room to avoid Packs. After the Long Stretch North-East the Door Icon appears on the Minimap, move up the Steps to find the Boss Arena Entrance.

Lunaris Concourse is following the same Static Layout Rules as Ebony Barracks in Act 3. The only Exception is the diffrence in Entrance / Exits. Lunaris Concourse has 2 additional Exits, but the Imperial Garden Exit is overgrown and removed.

You enter the Zone from the Bathhouse Entrance, the Waypoint is North-East of the Entrance. From the Waypoint the head North-West for Lunaris Temple Entrance. The Exit can either face North or East. You can see the Door Icon on the Minimap when aproaching it.
The Entrance to the Harbour Bridge is South-East of the Waypoint.
Waypoint
Follow the Carpet
Lunaris Temple 1 in Part 2 is a cleaned up Version of its Part 1 Variant.
Follow the Carpet North-East till you get to the big Room with the Rows of Banks. From there the Carpet either Splits of East or West. Follow it until the next big Room.
If the Carpet splits of East. Head North-East, while sticking to the West Edge
If the Carpet splits of West. Head North-West, while sticking to the West Edge, with the Exception of the first Door West.
Lunaris Temple 2 of Part 2 Act 8 follows the same Layout Rules as Lunaris Temple 2 of Part 1 Act 3 with the Exception that the South-West Layout either does not exist or is to rare for me to find.

The first Part of Lunaris Temple 2 is a Maze created by a series of Bridges. There are 3 notable Dead End Rooms, Square, Rectangle, and Double Platform. It is recommended to familirize with their Shapes on the Minimap to identify early and avoid.

The Maze has 3 Layers. connected by 3 long staircases. The first and second Layer are always connected by 2 Staircases. So the first Stair does not determine the Layout Direction yet. So to traverse the first and second Layer of the Maze take one Direction and search for the Staircase. IF you find it take the Staircase, otherwise change direction and repeat. Once you have found the 2nd Staircase, the third one will be facing the same Direction as the 2nd one.
You can go clockwise our counterlclockwise, just always stick to the same Pattern.
The second Part of Lunaris Temple is semi-static. It consist of a long Pathway, 2 big Gateways, a Cage Maze and a final Walkway leading to the Piety Fight.

For the first long Pathway look at the Flower Pots right next to the 3rd Staircase, you can determine the Correct direction based on which side only has one Flower Pot. If you have a North Layout, the Path will be one Long L Piece, with 1 Turn before you reach the first Gate. The second Gate in a North Layout will always be in a direct Line from the first Gate. After that follow the Walkway 2 Stairs up to find the Boss Arena.

On a South Variant, the Path will take few more turns, but will also end on the first Gate. After the First Gate the 2nd Gate will be in a adjacent Direction from it. The rooms leading up to the 2nd Gate will force the Player to walk in a U-Pattern. If the Stairs in the first Part faced East, then the 2nd Gate will also face East, so move East on the U-Pattern.
Sealed Casket Clarissa, to start Tolmen resurrection
Follow along the Left Edge (Waterside) from the Start

Quay's North Edge is made of Housewalls or Rubble while it's South Edge is the Waterside. In the first Section of the Zone we want to stick to the Waterside and move along the Direction the Zone extends to. This gurantees us to find the Ankh in the Sealed Casekt. Whenever the Zone splits we choose the West Option, if no West Option exist the South Option until we find the Resurrection Side. After the Resurrection Side we have to backtrack to the last Split and chose the other Route, once you see the Housewalls again stick to the North Edge till you find the Grain Gate Entrance.
Waypoint

Sarn Ramparts has 2 Variants, however we read and run them exactly the same. Move East till you hit the Rampart Wall, continue East along the Wall. At the Corner move North along the Rampart Wall. Enter the top of the Wall at the broken Wall Section. Walk on top of the Wall till you see a Staircase going down. At the Staircase move West/East to enter Town.
Waypoint

Underbelly places us at a random Place on the Base Layer of Solaris Concourse. Solaris Concourse has the same Layout and Variants as Battlefront in Act 3. The first step is to find anything to orient with. Move east to check if you are in the Dock Spawn Variant,
if you see a massive Wall you can Blink Arrow / Lightning Warp / Leap Slam up. Move North from there to find the Exit.
if you see a Edge (Housewall), backtrack until you can move North, then move North till you find the Solaris Temple Entrance.

if you find neither Wall or Edge, move North till you see the Ledge, from there move further North till you see the River. Follow the River to the Fountain, then move behind the Fountain for the Solaris Temple Entrance.
Waypoint
Normally we enter the Zone through Imperial Field from the East, however we enter it from the West due to new Pathing.
A Side Effect is a simplified Pathing through Solaris Temple 1.
We move East from the Entrance till we see the Waypoint.
If the Waypoint is in the West Corner of the Room, move North behind the Waypoint to see the Exit to Solaris Temple 2.
If the Waypoint is in the East Corner, move North till you get into a Room splitting of West, take West there to find the Solaris Temple 2 Entrance.

Solaris Temple 2 has diffrent Layouts in Part 2 compared to Part 1. We always head South at the Start and depending on the Shape and Connections the Room below the Starting Room has we know which direction the Zone extends to.
If the Room continues West or has a Door leading West, it is a West Layout. Follow the North Edge West till you find the Final Room, where Diala waited in Act 3.
Otherwise you have a East Variant, follow the North Edge East till you can move North.

Rarely it is the Loop Variant, where you have have to follow the Zone further West after moving North before you see the final Room. You can notice this Layout when you move North and aren't in the final Room already.
The Sewer Door at the Entrance is either open towards East or West. The Zone can only extend East if the Gate opens West, but could always be East regardless if the Sewer Door swings East or West.
Do one of the two
Always go opposite the Direction the Door opend.
Or always go West first as there are 2 West Variants.
After you have found the direction the Zone extends to, always move North if you can, if you can not move North, move the direction the Zone extends to.
I have not tested which one is overall better in 100+ Runs. Statisticly both are a 2/3, but not all Layouts feel as common.
Belly of the Beast is a Series of long twisted Tunnels. It is one of the biggest Zones in Path of Exile 1, based on Minimap Size. To identify which variant you are in there are 2 Identifier.

Only one Layout enters from the North and has no Square in the first Section. If you have the Entrance from North the Zone will take a Curve East. Follow the Zone till the first Split of North-West. Follow the Split Path till you find a Cross Section, head North-West again till the Path Splits of West, then follow the West Tunnel Westwards till you see the Exit.
All other Variants have a Square and Entrance is from the East. You know that you entered the Square at the first Split.

If you enter the Square from the North, take the West Path, in 2/3 Cases it is the correct Path and the Exit to the Square is in the Left Corner either North or East, however the rest of the Zone is the exact same Read. Follow the Path till you can move North, then move North till you can move East. Finally follow the Path till you can move North again, then move North till the Exit

If the Left Corner of the Square has no Exit follow the Square till you find the Exit South, then follow the Path South till it splits of West, take the West Tunnel till you can move North. Follow the Path North to find the Exit.
If you enter the Square from the West, always go straight East.

If the Square exits in the Top Right Corner east, go North once you can till you can split of West or reach the Cross Section. In any other Layout this would be the Tripple Dead End, but in this one (if no Split West happend before) the West Path is the Correct one. Follow that Tunnel till you can move North again. Take the Norht Tunnel till it splits East and the East Split will lead to the Exit.

Finaly if the Square exits in the Bottom Right Corner follow the Tunnel till the zone curves North. Don't take the first Split North, wait for the Curve. After the Curve follow the Path, if it splits in a T-Section take the West Path and continue to follow the Path North till it splits West. Take the West Curve and follow the Path till you find the Exit. If it splits/ has a Crosssection one more Time, take the North Split.

Can we have 3 Second of Silence for my Sanity trying to gather all Belly of the Beast Variants and learn their Identifiers. I despise this Zone, not for it's complexity, but the Time spend trying to understand it.
Waypoint

Blood Aqueduct in Part 2 is a Bloody Version of Aqueduct in Part 1 Act 4. Move North-East to find the Town Entrance, if your Path ends there will be a Bridge to the other Walkway acroos the Aqueduct. Repeat till you find the Town Entrance.
The Sidepassages still contain guranteed Magic Packs, which are great for Leveling.
Head North-East into the North Corner
Boiling Lake is another Semi Static Layout, while the Exact Zone isn't always the same the Important Location is.

The Basilisk is always in the North Corner, you can spot it based on the Terrain. There are 2 major identifier. First the Stone Statues only spawn in the North Corner and Second the 2 Sulphur Fountains next to the Ledge, forming a Smiley on the Minimap Additonaly the Zone consist of several Layers, with the Entrance being on the 2nd Layer and the Basilisk being on the 3rd Layer, the Ledge of the Smiley forms a 4th Layer, that slopes towards the Basilisk.
Supply Hoist, to get from one Layer to the Next
Descent starts the same as Ascent from Part 1 Act 5, however the Bridge is ripped and we have to descent instead. The Zone consist of 3 Layers connected by Supply Hoists.
The first Layer is always Static and the Exit is North-East of the Entrance along the West Edge of the first Layer.
The 2nd and 3rd Layer are either both vertical or both Horizontal. You can determin which variant you are in the moment you exit the Supply Hoist.
If the 2nd Layer starts in a East Tunnel you are in the Vertical Zone Variant and you move South-East to find the Supply Hoist to the next Layer or Exit.

If the 2nd Layer starts in a West Tunnel, you are in the Horizontal Variant and you move in the 2nd Layer South-West into North-West after crossing a Bridge. And East / South-East into North-East to find the Exit.
Waypoint

Foothills is a Semi Static Layout. The Zone consist of several Layers and always extends North-East. The Waypoint and entrance to Boiling Lake is on the 2nd Layer on the North Edge and the Exit to Tunnel is on the 4th Layer in the North-East Corner.

From the Entrance move North-East onto the 2nd Layer and further North-East to find the Waypoint. Then from the Waypoint move North-West till you hit the West Edge then further North. If you hit the North Edge, head West along the North Edge.
Stick to the East Edge. If you start at the North Corner, move South. Otherwise move North
Oasis either extends North,South or West. While it is a big open Zone like Vastiri Desert, the Variant can quickly be identified.
If you spawn at the East Edge, you are in the West Variant and the Sand Pit is in the West Corner.
Otherwise it is the North or South Zone with a East Edge Spawn.
If the Zone let's you move North, you are in the North Variant. Otherwise you are at the North Corner and the Sand Pit Boss Arena is in the South Corner.
Once you have identified the direction the Zone extends to head into that direction along the East Edge of the Zone.
Waypoint Locked Belly of the Beast Entrance Sin, to unlock Belly of the Beast Entrance
Refinery is mostly a Static Layout, but it has a rare Variant where both the Refinery Exit and the Garukhan Boss Arena are on the same East Edge.
From the Entrance always move North-East to find the Waypoint from the Waypoint move North-East to find either the Refinery Entrance or Garukhan Boss Arena
If the Refinery Entrance is East of the Waypoint, the Garukhan Boss Arena is South-West.
If the Garukhan Boss Arena is East of the Waypoint, the Refinery Entrance is North. Move along the North Edge West till you find the Entrance (after killing Garukhan).
The Boss Arena is in the North Corner, follow the East Edge
Refinery has 4 Variants, while the Spawn Room is the same in each Instance, the Outdoor Area surrounding it and the Connection to the next Room is unique to each Variant.

If the Outdoor Zone has no Connection indoor North or West, but an Entrance directly East then you are in the Small Outdoor Area Variant. Move North-East through the first Indoor Room, in the Outdoor Area directly enter through the opposite Door. Move North-East through the 2nd Indoor Area and in the final Outdoor Area move North-East till you see the Boss Room.

If the Outdoor Zone has no Connection indoor North or West and is extending East. Follow the Outdoor Area along the North Edge till you see a Entrance, go through the Indoor Area North-East and North East again in the 2nd Outdoor Area to find the Boss Room.
If the First Zone can be imeaditly exited North you are in the Outer Edge Variant, just follow the West Edge North. In the 2nd Indoor Area move North-East and do the same in the 3rd Outdoor Area.

Finally if the First Zone can be Excited South-West after moving North, follow the Inner Edge to leave the first Indoor Room and find the Entrance to the 2nd Indoor Room. Leave the 2nd Indoor Zone North-East and move again North-East in the last Outdoor Zone to find the Boss Room.
Second Tunnel in Main Room Follow the Zone in the Dreams

Rotting Core is 4 Static Layouts packaged into one. On the Main Zone move South-West, ignore the first Tunnel North, take the second. The Second Tunnel directly leads to the Entrance to the Core, while the First one curves East first.

Do the Dreams in any Order. The Dreams are linear with no Dead Ends. Shavronne's and Maligaro's Dreams are going North-West, while Doedre's is going North-East. So just follow the Zone in that Direction to find the Boss Rooms.
Waypoint Trial of Ascendancy
Exit is North East Trial is first Tunnel Split East/West

Tunnel is a long Linear Zone. The Trial is always in the First Tunnel splitting of East or West. In 2 Variants you can see the Book Icon from the Trial on the Minimap, but one Variant takes a U-Curve and is a bit further away. So seeing the Book Icon is not a foolproof Indicator. After the Trial follow the Zone North East till you reach the Exit.
Waypoint Storm-Weathered Chest Locked Oasis Entrance

Vastiri Desert is a big open Area with little Indicators. We know that the Storm-Weathered Chest is either North, East, South or West of the Waypoint and we know that the Waypoint is always East of the Entrance.
So we have 3 Objectives when going through Vastiri Desert.
Finding the Waypoint
Finding the Storm Blade
Finding the Exit to Foothills
On the 2nd Entering we have 1-2 Objectives
Finding the Storm Blade (if not done already)
and want to find Oasis Entrance

Always aim to find the Waypoint first. If you find the Stormblade on the West Spot before the Waypoint, imediatly go for the Exit North of the Waypoint after activating the Waypoint. Otherwise check if the Storm-Weathered Chest is West of the Waypoint. Move West till you hit the Edge, if no Storm-Weathered Chest, move North-East to diagonal East above the Waypoint, if you hit the Edge again before finding the Chest, the Chest is in the South Corner of the Zone. Otherwise you should see the Quest Indicator for the Storm-Blade.
On the 2nd Entrance to the Zone, if you haven't found the Stormblade yet, move South-West till you see the Quest Indicator and Log / Portal. Then head North-East to find the Oasis Entrance.
Follow Zone. Move North if able to
Canals has 2 Variants. Distinguishable by the first T-Section after the first Bridge. Check West Tunnel first.
If West Tunnel is a Dead End, it is the East Variant. Follow the Tunnel East. You are either forced in a Ziz Zag until you reach the next Bridge or get a 2nd T-Section.
If you have another T-Section and have Blink Arrow / Lightning Warp move West to find a Skip across a broken Bridge.

Continue to follow the Passage, on the Open Zone / Crosssection stick to the West Edge. afterwards follow the next Passage till you find a 2nd open Zone. The Correct Exit to the 2nd Open Zone is North. After its West into the final Passage to find the Exit to Feeding Through.
IF the West Tunnel continues, we got the West Variant. Follow the Passage.
If you reach a open Area, there is a Skip available North with Blink Arrow / Lightning Warp. then head North to reach the Open Area.
Otherwsie you reach a T-Section choose South here, and continue to follow the Passage till you reach the Open Area.
Go Straight Across the open Area and after North-East to find the final Passage leading to the Entrance to Feeding Through.
Rescue Bannon North of the Entrance, Exit is South-East Corner. Always head South East.
Cathedral Rooftop is a Semi Static Zone, the main layout is the same, but sometimes the Middle of the Rooftop is blocked and you have to walk East on a Wooden Scaffold.

Bannon is always right next to the Entrance in the former Kitava Boss Fight Arena. The Exit is always in the South-East Corner. Move South-East and stay in the Middle of the Roof. If the Path is Blocked like in Image 2 above, look for the Wooden Scaffolding East and take the Passage.
Waypoint
Move along the North Edge West. The Boss Arena Entrance is in the North-West Corner

Control Blocks is a reverse Run of the Act 5 Version. The Entrance is in the North-East Corner and the Boss Arena Entrance is in the North-West Corner. While it is possible to just follow the North Edge. It is faster to Dash down in the first Trench and use its Direction (Horizontal or Vertical) to identify the Layout.
If the Trench is Horizontal follow it till it ends. In the Top West Corner should be a broken Gate, Dash up and continue North-West to find the Boss Arena.

If the Trench is Vertical, Dash Down at the first Chance and move North-West along the Trench, Dash back up on the West Edge when possible and continue West when you can. The Boss Arena will be in the North-West Corner, thought sometimes it spawns a bit further out.
Waypoint
Desecrated Chambers is a ruined Version of Chambers of Innocence. The Zone generates Exactly the same, just visual Differences (and the Boss is not Innocence).
Head West along the North Edge, till you reach the first Elevated Layer curving South. If there is a Passage right below it, that Passage will lead to the Boss Room.
Otherwise continue West till you find the next Passage South. Then that Passage will lead to the Boss Room.
Sin, to open Kitava Boss Arena

Feeding Through is a Static Zone. 2 Walkways next to a Canal filled with Blood and Corpses. Kitava's Boss Arena is always in the North-Corner of the Zone. Both Walkways can be used to reach the Boss. The West Walkway is recommended as it contains a Crafting Recipe and is closer to Sin. Just walk in a Straight Line North-East.
Trial of Ascendancy Sealed Chest ( Elixir of Alure for 2 Respec Points) Forbidden Archive, containing Heretical Tome
Follow one Edge till you find the Trial

The Ossuary itself is filled with Skulls & Bones. Instead the Passage to the Bone Pits is now open. Bonepits has 4 Variants. Each Variant is either a 8-Shape or a Infinity-Shape. We can differentiate the Variants based on the Starting Location, but can't identify if it is a 8-Shape or Infinity-Shape until after the first Curve.
If you start facing East you are on the West Edge. Move North-East till you reach the first corner, move South-East till you get to the Big Room. From there move North-East to find the Trial.

If instead of reaching the Big Room you are forced to move South-West, continue to follow the Zone to reach the Big Room. From there stick to the East Edge South to find the Trial. You should be seeing the Lever Icon on the Minimap when forced to move South-West.
If you start facing West, you are on the West Edge. Move South-West till you reach the first corner, move South-East till you get to the Big Room. From there move South-West to find the Trial.

If instead of reaching the Big Room you are force to move North-East, continue to follow the Zone to reach the Big Room, cross it and continue to move North-East till you reach the Corner, from there move South-East to find the Trial.
Waypoint Innocence (once Revived), to unlock the Canals Entrance

Ravaged Square is a static Layout, it will always look the same. The Keydifference to its Act 5 Variant Ruined Square is that the North Bridge is broken. (And that you enter the Zone at the Cathedral Rooftop)
The Blood Fountain is always South-East of the Entrance.

The Waypoint is North-East from the Blood Fountain, if you have Blink Arrow / Lightning Warp, you can move North-East and dash over the Broken Bridge. Otherwise head South-East into East to cross the lower Bridge. Then head North till you can move East again to find the Waypoint.
The Torched Courts Entrance is South of the Waypoint in the Snake Pattern, follow the Zone.

Control Blocks Entrance is South-West of the Blood Fountain, move South-West till you find a opening in the Wall made of Houses, head through and repeat one more Time to find the Entrance to Control Blocks.
Torched Courts is a reverse Run of its Act 5 Version. The Zone is Semi-Static, the Entrance and Exit are Paralel to each other.

For the First Section avoid Rooms, try to go through the Corridors and move East till you hit the East Edge. Move South to reach the Courtroom. From the Courtroom start heading West, if the Room you path through only exits North or South, take the South Path and continue West afterwards. When reaching the same Height as the Entrance again, head North to find the Exit to Desecrated Chambers.

steps.text: 延岸跑，路上開箱子拿技能石，開門進城 。
出城到 暮光海灘，不打小怪一直跑到傳送點 。
跑到 炙熱鹽沼，開始打怪並拿三個螺開路，進 海潮地穴 踩傳送點 。
傳送回 暮光海灘，往下跑到 海潮孤島，殺拿醫藥箱 。
回城找人拿跑藥和技能石 。
傳送到 海潮地穴，跑到中間開傳送門（或水聲之淵門口開門，別進去一會兒才來）。
形往上跑到 沉寂海崖 踩點，殺掉圖騰跑進 碎岩山坡 。
踩點後一路跑到 禁靈之獄下層，走幾步踩點回城 。
走傳送門回到 海潮地穴，往剛才出口相反的方向跑去地洞二層 水聲之淵，殺蟹（天賦點任務）。
回城傳送去 禁靈之獄下層 (帝王迷宮試煉1) 。
解完試煉出來一路跑去上層殺 典獄長 。
殺完出口踩點回城拿位移技能 。
傳送 監獄大門，跑到 魅影船墓 踩傳送點 。
下 魅影船墓洞穴 拿任務物品，跑上地面。往上一直跑到 怨憤之窟 。
踩點傳送回 魅影船墓，向右找到船長殺之（天賦點任務）。
傳送回 怨憤之窟，向右跑到 怨憤之窟深處，向右跑，殺關底首領（職業玩家到這裡20分鐘左右）。
往上跑到森林營地 。
出城跑到 前哨原野 。
往右進入 危機岔路，踩點回城回到 前哨原野 。
在地圖中找到 獸穴，殺白野獸 。
找人拿跑瓶 。
傳送去 危機岔路，沿路往左上跑進入 罪孽之殿 。
中心傳送點的右上方進入 罪孽之殿二層 (帝王迷宮試煉2) 。
解完迷宮出來殺掉第二層的首領 。
回城向左穿過 河道（踩傳送點），沿路跑進入 西部密林 。
沿路去踩點，然後往右下跑到牆，延著牆往右上進入到 織網者巢穴 殺蜘蛛首領 。
回城傳送到 危機岔路，往右下過兩張圖到 寂靜陵墓一層 (帝王迷宮試煉3) 。
傳回 危機岔路，往右到 河畔斷橋，沿著路跑踩傳送點後到底殺掉盜賊 。
回城 河道，往上跑到 濕地，直走殺盜賊 。
在濕地跑踩點傳送 西部密林 。
走剩下的方向跑去幫忙或殺死艾莉亞（殺掉獲得2天賦點）。
沿著牆跑去路口殺黑旗軍回森林營地找艾米爾拿開路道具 。
傳送到 濕地，往上開樹根進入 瓦爾廢墟，過通道到達 北部密林 踩點 。
傳送回第一章獅眼守望拿天賦點 。
傳到 北部密林 沿著牆跑到 瀑布洞穴（注意，不是驚魂樹洞）(跑速工藝)，穿過它來到 古金字塔 。
上樓頂殺首領 。
回城傳送去第三章（37分鐘左右）。
往上跑與人對話然後進入 。
進城以後直接從上面的出口進入 貧民窟 。
穿過 貧民窟 到 火葬場 (帝王迷宮試煉4) 。
解完試煉出來殺派蒂，回程拿下水道鑰匙 。
回 貧民窟，進入下水道 。
拿了3個半身像（天賦點任務）再跑出 市集地帶 踩點 。
進入 黑石陵墓一層 (帝王迷宮試煉5) 。
傳送回市集，直接跑到 激戰廣場 。
踩點，旁邊貨車拿任務物品，往上跑進 不朽海港 拿硫酸 。
回城，拿技能書 。
傳送 激戰廣場，往右上進入 日曜神殿 。
跑到2樓對話拿項鍊和任務物品 。
傳回下水道，往左去 烏旗兵營 踩點 。
往上跑殺掉將軍，繼續往上跑進入 月影神殿 。
跑到二樓殺派蒂 。
回城拿獎勵，去藏身處工藝補電抗 。
傳送 烏旗兵營，向右跑到 皇家花園，踩點後向左上跑 (帝王迷宮試煉6) 。
回到 皇家花園 往右跑進入 神權之塔 。
衝到頂殺神主（60分鐘左右）。
向北直衝進城直接往左去 乾涸湖岸，殺掉福爾 。
回城，跑左邊去 漆黑礦坑 。
下二層，先解救靈魂（天賦點任務），再去 水晶礦脈 。
踩點，進 德瑞索的環境 。
進 大競技場，踩了點就傳送回 水晶礦脈 。
進 岡姆的幻境，一路跑到底殺岡姆 。
回城，傳送去 大競技場，殺德瑞索 。
回城，傳送去 水晶礦脈，開啟 巨獸沼澤 。
衝沖沖，殺派蒂-3小王-馬拉凱 。
回城往上和人對話，跑出城開傳送器去第五章（1:20 左右）。
奴役監牢 跑到底殺首領進城 。
直接走左邊出口去 鎮壓地帶，先找到探測棒（天賦點任務）。
鎮壓地帶 殺首領，去 奧瑞亞大廣場 。
往右上跑到 神聖大教堂 。
右邊形迴路走進 無罪之室 。
貼牆跑到 潔白聖殿 殺爆伊爾莉斯 。
右下出門跑去 焚燒大教堂 。
向上跑個倒形迴路找到 大廣場廢墟 。
貼牆走左邊一點點路進入 葬骨禮堂（門口有傳送點）。
拿純淨之印，回城拿獎勵 。
去過帝王迷宮 。
傳送回  大廣場廢墟，往左過橋往左下進入 聖物間，拿到三件奇塔弗的折磨（天賦點任務）。
傳送回  大廣場廢墟，往左邊過橋左上找到去 聖堂屋頂。
直線跑去奇塔弗房間 。
打完去藏身處補抗性，然後找過劇情（1:40 左右）。
右邊出去 暮光海灘，跑到 炙熱鹽沼 。
殺長老，直奔 卡魯堡壘 。
殺進卡魯堡壘，進入 破碎山脊 。
踩了點直接開回城卷，左邊出門全清 絕望岩灘 。
傳送 破碎山脊，跑到 禁靈之獄 (殘酷帝王試煉1) 。
做完試煉直接跑 薛朗監塔 塔頂，殺薛朗的創造物 。
監獄大門 踩點，回城拿4連頭。
傳送 監獄大門，沿著牆進 飲焰者的災變山谷 殺羊人首領（天賦點任務）。
回到 監獄大門，沿路跑到 西部密林/河道，踩點，往左上進入 濕地
進入 纏盤蛛絲洞 殺傀儡女王首領（天賦點任務）。
傳送 河道，向東穿過 南部森林 進入 忿怒山洞 拿黑旗 。
穿過洞窟，到 絕望烽塔 。
送火炬，下樓和港口船邊的人對話航行到 海洋王堡礁 。
跑到首領房間打完，回城直接傳送到第七章（2:00 左右）。
進入 橋墩營地 。
往上出城到 河畔斷橋，沿著路跑，遇到銀色吊墜就拿了（暴擊瓶任務），然後繼續回到路上跑到 危機叉路 。
在 危機叉路 沿著路跑到傳送點，往下進入 墮道遺跡 。
再沿路跑到 寂靜陵墓 (殘酷帝王試煉2) 。
做完試煉，繼續在寂靜陵墓裡面找到石棺下樓，拿任務物品馬雷格羅的地圖 。
